name: smwsprites-flying-items
title: Flying Items
description:
A flying mushroom, fire flower, feather, star or 1-up, depending on the extra byte, that flies and ascends just like the unused flying red coin and yellow 1-up in the vanilla game. Setting the extra bit makes it fly to the left rather than to the right. The extra byte settings are explained in the .asm file!

Requested by Overcrow03.
